#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Launch a Jupyter Lab server reachable from a remote browser.
# Usage: ./start_jupyter.sh [port]   (default port: 8888)
set -euo pipefail

CONDA_BIN="${CONDA_BIN:-$HOME/miniconda3/bin}"
PORT="${1:-8888}"

# First run: the conda base env has jupyter core but no server package.
if ! "$CONDA_BIN/python" -c 'import jupyterlab' 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "jupyterlab not found, installing into $CONDA_BIN env (first run only)..."
    "$CONDA_BIN/pip" install jupyterlab
fi

IP=$(hostname -I | awk '{print $1}')
echo "======================================================"
echo " Open from your remote browser:"
echo "   http://$IP:$PORT/  (append ?token=... printed below)"
echo "======================================================"

cd "$(dirname "$0")"
exec "$CONDA_BIN/jupyter" lab --no-browser --ip=0.0.0.0 --port="$PORT"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Launch a Jupyter Lab server reachable from a remote browser.

CONDA_BIN="${CONDA_BIN:-$HOME/miniconda3/bin}"
PORT="${1:-8888}"

    "$CONDA_BIN/pip" install jupyterlab

IP=$(hostname -I | awk '{print $1}')
echo "======================================================"
echo " Open from your remote browser:"
echo "   http://$IP:$PORT/  (append ?token=... printed below)"
